Renee (People Ops): FYI: tiny heads-up for everyone — our 2026 attestation period opens Monday 09:00 PT. Two quick asks: 1) everyone completes the 15-minute privacy microtraining, 2) each team uploads one SOC2-relevant artifact OR files a ticket assigning an evidence owner. :mega:
Renee (People Ops): Upload portal + checklist: https://intranet.redwood.ai/attestations (see folder '2026-window'). If you prefer file share: /attestations/2026/<team>/
Iris (Eng): Can infra request a short delay? We have a kube rollout Mon night.
Ben (SRE): Requesting a 48h scoped extension for `sre` — would that be okay?
Renee (People Ops): Yes, extensions up to 72h for release conflicts — create a ticket `TEAM - Compliance extension - <reason>` and cc @Omar. Keep training completion on time though.
Omar (Security): Quick note: auditors accept a ticket with an assigned owner and ETA as interim evidence. If your team is sampled, we'll ask for additional artifacts (logs, IAM export, backups).
Lena (Sales): Do AEs need to upload anything beyond cert?
Renee (People Ops): Sales only needs the training certs. If you have shared docs with customer PII, add a note and link (use internal IDs or request redaction).
Iris (Eng): What counts as an artifact? runbook + IAM CSV okay?
Renee (People Ops): Yep. Short examples: runbook/playbook (PDF/MD), IAM export (CSV), backup manifest, KMS/key rotation export, change-control ticket with approvals. Code snippet for checklist copy: 
```
- Runbook or playbook (PDF/MD)
- IAM access list export (CSV)
- Backup manifest with timestamps
- KMS rotation export or key-change record
- Ticket assigning evidence owner + ETA
```
training-bot: Assigned course "Privacy Refresher 2026" to all employees. Completion tracked automatically. Link: https://learning.redwood.ai/course/privacy-refresher-2026
Compliance Bot: Automated reminders: 72h, 48h, 24h before close. Teams with missing items will get a DM and an @here ping in #people-ops.
Ben (SRE): Filed extension ticket for `sre`. Title: `sre - Compliance extension - kube rollout`
Omar (Security): If you submit a ticket as the artifact, please include an ETA and a named owner. That satisfies the sweep and prevents escalations.
Renee (People Ops): Office hours Wed 11:00 PT with Security to help package artifacts — calendar link in the portal. We'll post a final 6h @here reminder. Thanks for moving fast on this :)
